note: Mr. Cadabra's TALKING clips (build ev). These carry his real ElevenLabs voice and are NOT muted -- unlike presence.json's corner loops, which are silent forever. Sources are H.264/AAC mp4 only, deliberately: for these clips VP9/webm encoded LARGER than the mp4 at matched quality (1.53MB vs 1.15MB), and H.264 plays in every browser that ships to consumers. The player builds <source> lists, so adding an encoding later is a manifest edit, not a code change -- and a browser that cannot decode any listed source falls back to the page's existing behaviour, which is tested.

site_welcome.caption: Well, hello there — welcome to Mr. Cadabra's Classroom! I'm Mr. Cadabra. In my classroom we do math out loud, together, one step at a time — and nobody gets left behind. Have a look around, and when you're curious, come try a real lesson with me. I'll be right here.

demo_welcome.caption: Welcome to my demo! In a moment I'll show you around the classroom, and then — if you're brave enough — I'll teach you a real lesson, any level you like, from counting all the way to calculus. Have fun. Let's go!
